en.text: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

zhSimplified.text: 带着他的妻子与，并一切所有的，都从上南地去。

zhTraditional.text: 帶着他的妻子與，並一切所有的，都從上南地去。

en.text: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

zhSimplified.text: 他从南地渐渐往去，到了和的中间，就是从前支搭帐棚的地方，

zhTraditional.text: 他從南地漸漸往去，到了和的中間，就是從前支搭帳棚的地方，

en.text: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.

zhSimplified.text: 也是他起先筑坛的地方；他又在那里求告耶和华的名。

zhTraditional.text: 也是他起先築壇的地方；他又在那裏求告耶和華的名。

en.text: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

zhSimplified.text: 与同行的也有牛群、羊群、帐棚。

zhTraditional.text: 與同行的也有牛群、羊群、帳棚。

en.text: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

zhSimplified.text: 那地容不下他们；因为他们的财物甚多，使他们不能同居。

zhTraditional.text: 那地容不下他們；因為他們的財物甚多，使他們不能同居。

en.text: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，人与人在那地居住。的牧人和的牧人相争。

zhTraditional.text: 當時，人與人在那地居住。的牧人和的牧人相爭。

en.text: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

zhSimplified.text: 就对说：「你我不可相争，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相争，因为我们是骨肉。

zhTraditional.text: 就對說：「你我不可相爭，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相爭，因為我們是骨肉。

en.text: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

zhSimplified.text: 遍地不都在你眼前吗？请你离开我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。」

zhTraditional.text: 遍地不都在你眼前嗎？請你離開我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。」

en.text: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

zhSimplified.text: 举目看见的全平原，直到，都是滋润的，那地在耶和华未灭、以先如同耶和华的园子，也像地。

zhTraditional.text: 舉目看見的全平原，直到，都是滋潤的，那地在耶和華未滅、以先如同耶和華的園子，也像地。

en.text: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

zhSimplified.text: 于是选择的全平原，往东迁移；他们就彼此分离了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是選擇的全平原，往東遷移；他們就彼此分離了。

en.text: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

zhSimplified.text: 住在地，住在平原的城邑，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到。

zhTraditional.text: 住在地，住在平原的城邑，漸漸挪移帳棚，直到。

en.text: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 人在耶和华面前罪大恶极。

zhTraditional.text: 人在耶和華面前罪大惡極。

en.text: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

zhSimplified.text: 离别以后，耶和华对说：「从你所在的地方，你举目向东西南北观看；

zhTraditional.text: 離別以後，耶和華對說：「從你所在的地方，你舉目向東西南北觀看；

en.text: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

zhSimplified.text: 凡你所看见的一切地，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 凡你所看見的一切地，我都要賜給你和你的後裔，直到永遠。

en.text: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

zhSimplified.text: 我也要使你的后裔如同地上的尘沙那样多，人若能数算地上的尘沙才能数算你的后裔。

zhTraditional.text: 我也要使你的後裔如同地上的塵沙那樣多，人若能數算地上的塵沙才能數算你的後裔。

en.text: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。」

zhTraditional.text: 你起來，縱橫走遍這地，因為我必把這地賜給你。」

en.text: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 就搬了帐棚，来到、的橡树那里居住，在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛。

zhTraditional.text: 就搬了帳棚，來到的橡樹那裏居住，在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇。
